title: A schema is not yet a report: from two requests to checked rows
goal: Run the actual DCS processor for two of your own requests: verify two rows totaling 75 minutes, then one filtered row of 45 minutes.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P8. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A report says 75 minutes. Are these the intended two requests, or just a matching total? Identify the rows, then follow the complete data-composition pipeline and check what survives the filter.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

paragraphs: Continue your own P8 copy. Close Enterprise, save a DT backup and restore it into a new empty infobase; verify the actual path. Preserve prior work, records and the handler. Do not load a full CF over your work.

sections.title: A schema describes data
paragraphs: DCS means Data Composition System (СКД, система компоновки данных). It separates the description of available data, report settings and execution. Think of a report as a question: which records should it include, what should one row mean and which quantities should it total? Answer these questions before opening the designer. A resource is a value aggregated by the chosen rule; here Минуты is a duration in minutes.

The supplied complete module creates two requests belonging to your own customer, with durations of 30 and 45 minutes. It builds a DataCompositionSchema and outputs a collection containing document reference, customer and minutes. Before running it, predict two rows and a total of 75. The customer-reference filter isolates this experiment from earlier work in the infobase.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеОтчёты common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The function creates a separate customer and their 30-minute and 45-minute requests. The first DCS run returns two detail rows totalling 75. The condition “Минуты > 30” then retains the second request and 45. The two Yes messages identify different properties; they do not replace checking the actual rows.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Resources depend on granularity
paragraphs: An already customer-grouped dataset can be summed again only with correct multiplicity. A bad join doubles resources before DCS. Check raw query rows before report groupings. A computed field with a nice name cannot repair lost or extra records.

Follow the pipeline in order: the schema describes the query and fields; settings select fields and filters; the layout composer prepares the execution layout; the DCS processor executes it; the output processor returns a value table. DataPath (ПутьКДанным) names the field available to the composition system. Creating a schema object alone does not execute a report.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: What survives the strict condition “Минуты > 30”?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: The second request alone. 30 is not greater than 30, so the first is excluded. Check count, minutes, and the exact reference, rather than a coincidentally matching final number.

sections.title: Settings differ from the source set
paragraphs: One schema can support multiple report variants. Users change available fields, filters and groupings without silently gaining forbidden data scope. Check permissions and dataset restrictions separately. Preserve variant and parameters so another reviewer reproduces the same question.

This experiment returns detail rows only, without an extra total row. Sum their Минуты values once: 30 + 45 = 75. If you later add grouping and report totals, distinguish detail from aggregate rows so you do not add the same minutes twice. The shorthand 2/75 below means two rows totaling 75 minutes.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: A schema describes data, settings define the question, and execution produces rows. The 2/75 and 1/45 observations come from two runs over one own dataset. These are detail rows, not details added to a total row.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Using “>= 30” would retain both requests. Checking only a total can also miss one document substituted for another with the same minutes. The correct function checks the second request’s reference explicitly.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Accept from source evidence
paragraphs: A separate three-document example illustrates grouping: durations 30 and 45 for one customer and 15 for another give 90 minutes overall and customer totals 75 and 15. This is a different input from the two-document runnable experiment. In both cases compare actual document references as well as totals. A matching sum can conceal a missing record and an extra record of the same duration.

Recompose the same input with minutes>30: expect only the second reference/45. Changing the threshold to 45 yields no rows and distinguishes semantics despite valid syntax. Retain settings, source and both outputs.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: For new own requests of 20 and 60 minutes, compose all details, details strictly greater than 40, and details strictly greater than 60. Print the initial 2 rows/80 minutes; then 1 row/60 and the matching second reference; finally 0 rows at the 60 boundary. Use DCS and preserve the original 30/45 experiment and definitions.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.
